name: team_review_build
description: Team cycle (roadmap Phase 2, §4.3 review): build read-only peer-review forks for the items integrated this wave (H8). The reviewer is a different agent than the implementer (H13 — author is not the oracle); it reviews each item's isolated diff (waveBase..finalHead for the item's files) against its acceptance criteria and returns a structured lgtm/changes verdict. Items already reviewed maxReviewRounds times are not re-reviewed.

reviewing.description: Item ids integrated this wave, awaiting review.

waveBase.description: Shared head before the wave — the diff base.

maxReviewRounds.description: Bound on review rounds per item (H8).

dynamicTasks.description: FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC descriptors, one read-only coding_agent reviewer per item.

reviewed.description: Item ids a reviewer was dispatched for this wave.
